dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you going to find shelter?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm made of sterner stuff than that! Sure it's been a while since I last went on an adventure, but I'm not Master of the Guild for nothing you know!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: There's not an adventurer alive that would want to miss out on a sight like this!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: This is exactly how Mondstadt is said to have looked in the early days, according to the legends...
